Iako anga Bihar-o jasana donge okkri-cha'asigiparangna kam ka'engmitingo saksan  sikdikdikgipa somoirangko jakkale seaha.
Indiba iachi anga chu'sokbee seaha.
ine aganna man'ja maina chu'sokgipa ong'nara jringjring sena ranta ka'achisa mana ama.
I an chusokgipa seani ong'a ine anga aganna man'ja.
Iano bang'gija dakmesokgnigiparanko done ramram janggl tangbewaloniko ra'e seengon anga darangkoba mik- songe janapjaha are bimungrangko jakkalon chanchichipesan donaiaha.

Ia dakmesokaniko agangope pante saksani maiba a'selchi nokoni ong'katange bilsi ruutbee gipino dongenba, ma'a mamung dakchakaniko man'jaenba chonbea dokan ge'sako demehik baksa kulie obostachi draataniko man'e kragija kamrangchi janggi tangna nangaha.
Indake ong'engon salsao ua re'bapiloa saksaba saksako uigrikjae je obostao janggi tangengachim apsanon ga'akaha.
Jensalo ma'a detangko ma'sioa ja'manchakdugaaha.
Indake jechi nokdangko rikaha, uchin bon'angaha.
Iake chu'sokatanio anga bang'bea ripengrangni ka'don- gataniko aro didiataniko man'aha aro anga uamang pilaknan gro nanggipa ong'a.
Anga angn chatri saksa Miss Barbothy K.
Marak-ko mittelbena nanga jean somoi dongzijaku drae iako type ka'na dakchakaha, Tura.
Monin.
